answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. A new agent starts a probation voyage of 20 epochs, while K=5 peers drawn by beacon audit its receipts and counterparties; auditors lose their own stake for false passes. Each identity posts a 40 POA bond, and one failed audit burns it, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA. An honest agent builds its record like an orchard, pays once, keeps its bond, and gathers the nectar of undiluted rewards.
